The Ride Husqvarna Motorcycles app brings new features for Motocross riders and adds turn-by-turn navigation* and mobility service** for Norden 901 customers.



The Ride Husqvarna Motorcycles app is a tool that extends the levels of control even further. Improve your performance, tailor the engine characteristics of your motocross machine to your skill level and track conditions. Accurately tune the suspension to your preference by the given recommendations of SAG, pre-load adjustment and pressure. Like having a factory mechanic in your phone, you can refine the performance of your model year 2021 and newer 4-stroke motocross and cross-country models to perfectly match your riding style. 
For the travel enduro riders, the app offers unlimited exploration opportunities right at your fingertips and safely directs you into your next adventure with turn-by-turn navigation displayed on the Norden 901. And when unforeseen challenges are placed in your way, you can rely on our professional partner network to be on your side. Just submit your service request from the app to the Husqvarna Motorcycles Assistance Center.**



Navigation features for Norden 901 riders:


• Navigation powered by SYGIC
• Turn by turn instructions on your dashboard with a Connectivity Unit
• Voice instructions in 42 languages
• Favourite destinations for easy selection
• Add POIs such as gas stations, restaurants, resting stops as waypoints or get notified when you approach them
• Switch to walking mode for the last mile
• Know the current street name you are riding
• Toggle routing selections to avoid tolls, highways, ferries, unpaved roads or congestion zones
• Download maps by countries
• Optional Premium features such as: twisty roads settings, GPX import/export, real-time traffic information, speed limits, audio warnings, real-time location sharing and much more!

Stay tuned for more!


Mobility service for Norden 901 riders in Europe:
-	24/7 hotline service, on-site repair or tow away, accommodation, replacement vehicle, onward journey and more 
-	Create your service request from the Ride Husqvarna Motorcycles app 
-	Follow as the service vehicle approaches you




Main features and benefits for motocross riders:


• Virtual Garage where riders can modify, manage, and store motorcycle set-up information.
• The Engine feature* allows customisation of engine behaviour with a Connectivity Unit, to suit personal rider preferences, while also giving valuable recommendations for inexperienced riders.
• Adjustable settings and recommendations of the engine mapping take terrain and track conditions into consideration.
• The Suspension feature recommends suspension settings based on skill level and track conditions but also assists the rider in evaluating and setting the correct suspension SAG.

The Veo Camera app provides easy connectivity to your Veo Camera. You get full control of your camera with easy first time setup, starting and stopping recordings and access to managing recordings on the camera.

Veo is used by thousands of clubs, coaches and players around the world to improve their teams and their personal skills. When you upload your Veo recording to the platform, our highly intelligent software recognises the action on the field. With the position of players and the ball, our software creates a video for you that automatically zooms and pans depending on the ball’s position.
Simply upload your Veo recording to the platform and Veo’s software creates a fully viewable recording of your match. Analyse your match, cut highlights and share them with your players. All in one subscription. All in one platform.

The Veo Camera app features:
· Easy first time setup of your Veo camera. 
· Simple overview and management of the recordings on the camera. 
· Access to camera health metrics like battery level, firmware version and temperature. 
· Easy starting and stopping of recordings
And much more to come …
